items.title: How much does eviction junk removal cost in Katy, TX?
items.content: Eviction junk removal pricing in Katy depends on volume, property size, and services needed. Most single-unit cleanouts range from $300-$1,500. T&C Integrity provides free on-site estimates with transparent pricing and no hidden fees.

items.title: How fast can you clean out an eviction property in Katy?

items.title: Do you combine junk removal with deep cleaning in Katy?
items.content: Yes. We're one of the few Katy-area companies offering both junk removal and professional deep cleaning as a combined service. One team, one visit, one invoice — your property is completely turnover-ready.

items.title: What Katy neighborhoods do you serve?

items.title: Are you licensed and insured for Katy, TX?
items.content: Yes. T&C Integrity is fully licensed, bonded, and insured. All crew members are background-checked and trained for professional property cleanout work.

items.content: Absolutely. Many Katy properties are 3,000-5,000+ square feet. We have the crew size and equipment to handle large-scale cleanouts efficiently, and we're familiar with HOA requirements in Katy's planned communities.
